extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: 5.10.573: The Telegram bot answers (DexCloud hub 2.18): search and play on the TV from it, your Continue watching, Next episode, watch history and Home lists, all in Dex Hub's look. 5.10.572: Whole Blu-ray discs from Usenet play (a COMPLETE.BLURAY release is a disc image in a password-protected archive; with the Usenet engine 1.3.0 it opens) and open as a disc in Kodi; a Blu-ray image (.iso) from any Debrid or add-on link plays on the Mac, Apple TV, Android and Windows too, where Kodi hung or could not read one: Dex Hub reads the image over the internet and hands Kodi its disc folder; a disc with Java menus (most UHD discs) opens on its main film instead of stopping in its menu, a disc with plain menus opens in them, and on CoreELEC and LibreELEC (Java menus run there) every disc opens in its menu; Kodi's "Play main movie" setting is followed; a subtitle switched on in a disc's menus from any add-on plays the main film from the same place with it at once, no question, and stays; Dex Hub picks no subtitle itself in a disc's menus. 5.10.571: Whole Blu-ray discs from TorBox open in their own menus (intros, menu, chapters, languages; the film starts from the menu); StremThru Torz joins the built-in torrent sites, with new addresses for YTS, TorrentGalaxy, Zilean, MediaFusion and Comet; one row per release when it was uploaded under several hashes; a ready torrent with no video inside (a fake .exe, an archive) is no longer offered; an indexer that refuses a Usenet search says why; a TorBox torrent added only to play it is removed again when nothing of it plays. 5.10.570: Only torrent sources that work today: every well-known public add-on (Torrentio, Comet, Peerflix, MediaFusion, Meteor, TorrentsDB, Knightcrawler) is tried with a real search before it is added, looked at again weekly, and replaced or removed when it stops; the built-in sites try their other addresses and step aside for 30 minutes when none answers. 5.10.569: Built-in torrent scrapers (YTS, EZTV, TheRARBG, TorrentGalaxy, The Pirate Bay, Knaben, Zilean) asked together from this device, Peerflix added with Torrentio and Comet; a full Kodi backup, a backup of all of Kodi's settings, or Dex Hub alone, with a restore for each. 5.10.568: Debrid of its own: link Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or TorBox with a QR from your phone (Premiumize with its key), and torrents from Torrentio, Comet, any Stremio add-on, CocoScrapers or your own Debrid files play straight from your account; Torrentio and Comet are added for you, ready ones are marked, and no POV, Fen Light, Umbrella or Red Light is needed. 5.10.567: Blu-ray and DVD images: subtitle files work again (a disc opened at its resume point went to its menus, where they never show); Dex Hub keeps the disc's own subtitle in its menus and offers to play the main movie from the same place. 5.10.566: Mark intro in the player (where TheIntroDB has none, the season's other episodes skip it); SMB and NFS shares are named as such in Servers; the NAS search says in the log why it was not searched; turn an add-on off and on again from its menu, without removing it. 5.10.565: The sources page reads the plot in Arabic and the ratings for titles from a Nuvio profile's catalogs too (they stayed English), Classic shows two whole lines of plot, and Kodi's mounted video folders (CoreELEC, LibreELEC) join the NAS source. 5.10.564: The YouTube page laid out as the YouTube TV app: its side rail (Search, Home, Shorts, Music, Subscriptions, Library, Live, Gaming, Sports, News, Settings), its own shelves in its order, Shorts as tall cards, a SoundCloud-style music player with its queue, and a queue of videos no longer plays behind the page. 5.10.563: IPTV films and episodes, and YouTube videos, open the player again (they played behind the page); several server addresses per IPTV source, tried in turn; a provider's 5xx is asked once more and its own codes (like HTTP 513) explained. 5.10.562: The Aura sources page shows its ratings whole (no chip cut at the panel edge) and the plot in Arabic when the metadata language is Arabic. 5.10.561: NAS section titles play their NAS file directly from the title page, with the NAS file listed in Sources. 5.10.560: The Aura sources theme (default); IPTV films and series open the title page and play the provider file directly, with it listed in Sources; Xtream VOD plays again; DexWorld lists and playback from the provider when its server is blocked; Info on server Continue Watching items; a new default look. 5.10.559: Usenet on Apple TV: the engine now lives inside the Dex Hub Apple TV app itself, and the engine add-on starts it when a Usenet source is picked. 5.10.558: Usenet as a source of its own: your NNTP provider and Newznab indexers (Settings, Sources, Usenet), played on this device through a separate engine program (Mac and CoreELEC). 5.10.557: the source filter as a side panel with TRaSH Guides chips, the sources come back when nothing plays, EasyNews as a source, a subtitle from a file.
